{{Quote|Great! We normally only do inner city work as that's where our special skills work best but this client was desperate enough to pay extra, so we will make an exception. The client wants protection while repairing some harvesters and he will meet you just outside town.|[[Peawp R'dawc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RBA" />}}
'''Tobo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tobo hired the services of the [[R'dawc Bodyguard Agency]] to protect him because he needed to repair some harvesters in the hostile desert outside [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. A spacer working for [[Peawp R'dawc]] was therefore tasked to meet the Nikto and protect him at all costs. The spacer escorted Tobo and effectively defended him during subsequent attacks of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="SWG:RBA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tobo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tobo was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was involved in the quests given by Peawp R'dawc to beginner players who had chosen a "[[W:c:swg:Brawler|brawler]]" career.<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> The "brawler" profession was later removed from the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005" /> Peawp R'dawc's questline was widely revamped and Tobo was removed from these quests.<ref name="SWG:HHE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Hoodlums, Hoodlums Everywhere|Tatooine}}</ref>
